findings.evidence: The one PowerShell verification block runs 'rg -uu -n -F apex-build-orchestrator skills agents hooks' and '$hook -notmatch Engine -or -notmatch manual' as a single script, 'run from the build repo'. Live hooks/apex-session-context.md:32,43 still contains apex-build-orchestrator and has no 'Engine' or 'manual' match. Task 15 is a HOST step that runs after the coder tasks (Wave plan line 120).
findings.summary: The spec's own verify block cannot pass at coder or build-verify time. The hook rg check and the hook-content check only go green after the owner integrates Task 15. The block is not split into a pre-T15 coder subset and a post-T15 HOST subset. A builder running it as written gets a false failure, or is tempted to edit the protected hook. Label the hook-dependent lines as post-T15 HOST checks.

findings.evidence: Live skills/apex-code/SKILL.md:61 says an UNATTENDED/AFK build 'the agent is not dispatched and you perform this analysis yourself'. Lines 65 (a)-(f) hold the host-only structural checks (cap arithmetic, disjointness, authorized subset). Line 287 says 'the ORCHESTRATOR owns the pass/fail adjudication'. Task 1 replaces the whole block at ':59-65,281,287' with Engine text and says to 'remove all retired-agent/protocol pointers'. The only AFK direction is 'unchanged AFK ownership' in the hook (Task 15) and 'HOST AFK mechanics' in Task 11.
findings.summary: The draft never says where the AFK/manual host path gets its wave-analysis structural checks (a)-(f) and its verify-adjudication owner once the 'orchestrator-owned' text is removed. Task 1 could delete the only live description of those mechanics, leaving the manual path used by every refused spec and by AFK without an adjudicator. The draft should state which :61-65 content survives, retargeted to HOST, and name the adjudicating owner at :287.

findings.evidence: apex-engine.ps1:1713 requires -ReviewDigest to be 64 lowercase hex. apex-engine.ps1:1725 requires -ReviewRecord to be outside every Git worktree and an existing file. Task 1 only says '-ReviewDigest <hex> -ReviewRecord <absolute>'.
findings.summary: The host-facing review-flag instructions omit two Engine constraints: the 64-character digest and the record placed outside all worktrees. A Critic record written into the build worktree would be rejected. Add both constraints to the Task 1 text.

findings.evidence: The brief's open question asks that forks/spec-defect handling be covered as host actions. The draft lists the Forks section anchor (SKILL.md:319), but no task text or acceptance criterion addresses it.
findings.summary: Task 1 only says 'diagnose, adjust the spec or seek owner disposition' on exit 1. The assumption-wrong, unmeetable-criterion and GRAY fork rules at SKILL.md:319-328 are not tied to Engine parks, so adding the anchor to the listing does no work. Either add one sentence to T1 or drop the anchor.
